title: kith-peer: is_valid_mailbox_host rejects all Headscale hostnames — outbox fails for Headscale deployments
description: is_valid_mailbox_host (line 1124) accepts plain hostnames only if they end with '.ts.net'. The architecture doc explicitly supports Headscale as a canonical deployment and states Headscale users must use Tailscale-range IP addresses (100.64.0.0/10 or fc00::/7). However Headscale by default assigns addresses in the 100.64.x.x range so IP-based delivery should work, but any Headscale deployment using MagicDNS with its own domain (e.g. *.example.internal) will have all outbox deliveries permanently fail with 'invalid mailbox_host'. This is a latent footgun: works on Tailscale Inc., silently fails on Headscale with custom DNS. The comment says 'Headscale users must use Tailscale-range IP addresses' but this is not documented anywhere for operators and is easy to miss.
